preconditions.description: The divisor d is a positive integer within the range from 1 to 500.
The sum of digits s is a positive integer within the range from 1 to 5000.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output > 0 and output % d == 0 and sum_of_digits(output) == s)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no such number exists, or a positive integer n that is divisible by d and has a digit sum equal to s.
